xmlConvert.abortOomBody: This solution is too large for this machine's available memory. Run the import on a machine with more RAM (8 GB or more) or retry with a reduced memory profile.

xmlConvert.abortNoInputBody: All {{total}} files were skipped: {{legacy}} × FileMaker {{versions}} format (SaXML 2.0). fm-lab needs exports from FileMaker 19 or newer — open the files in FileMaker Pro 19+ and export them again via “Save a Copy as XML”. The solution's existing data is unchanged.
xmlConvert.abortNoInputBodyMixed: None of the {{total}} files could be imported ({{skipped}} skipped, {{failed}} failed). No catalogs were rebuilt — check the run log for details.
xmlConvert.skippedNoticeBody: Unsupported format (FileMaker 18 or older): {{files}}. Re-export with FileMaker 19 or newer; all other files were imported.
